Long-tail completion audit (2026-08-15). The reported 57-minute failed run is fully attributable, not a remaining mystery. Run 31834896849 lasted 57m29s. It was created at 19:47:56Z but its first clear-vote runner did not begin until 20:13:09Z: 25m13s of same-change admission delay behind change 1788 PS1 run 31834162663, whose final cast job ended at 20:13:06Z. The replacement began three seconds later. Its own macOS job then ran 30m23s (only 10s job queue) and ended failed; the workflow cast completed at 20:45:24Z. Thus the long wall clock was 25m13s stale-run serialization plus 30m23s macOS execution and normal routing/vote overhead, not one >30s test.

The admission mechanism was already proven and repaired on closed ticket esthetic-degrading-pupa / Gerrit 1792 / commit 4cbaa19315: seven full-route jobs used always(), so GitHub cancellation re-evaluated them true and let superseded work finish naturally. They now use !cancelled() while preserving classifier-failure full fallback. Organic post-merge change 1790 PS3->PS4 stopped the stale run in 78s and admitted its successor immediately afterward; PS4->PS5 independently stopped in 110s. This removes the 1,510s predecessor wait class and saved stale runner occupancy without changing tests, cells, selectors, assertions, or coverage.

Current-main run 31883105646 confirms the repaired steady path: 21m28s end-to-end, 2-3s job queues, max 13 simultaneous jobs, 60m48s successful-job occupancy, macOS 19m45s, and no individual test over 30s. There has been no later organic Verify run as of 12:27Z, so the final-optimization steady-state average remains N=1 and the parent stays in_progress pending organic sampling.
